$comment: Golden routing prompts — each entry states a realistic user request and the agent that agents/ROUTING.md + global-CLAUDE.md should route it to. Static checks (npm run routing-eval) verify structural integrity and agent coverage on every CI run; the live evaluation (RUN_ROUTING_EVAL=1, needs the claude CLI and API credits) actually asks the model to route each prompt and scores the answers. TR+EN mixed prompts are intentional — the kit advertises bilingual routing signals.
